test_HuffmanCodeBuilder_counting: test that HuffmanCodeBuilder correctly counts symbol frequencies from input data
test_HuffmanCodeBuilder_addition: test that HuffmanCodeBuilder supports addition to merge symbol counts from two builders
test_HuffmanCodeBuilder_io: test that HuffmanCodeBuilder can serialize to and deserialize from a file
test_HuffmanCoder_encode_decode: test that HuffmanCoder can encode sentences and decode them back to original symbols
test_HuffmanMMapIndexedDataset_append: test that HuffmanMMapIndexedDatasetBuilder can append multiple datasets and decode all symbols
